Hi Jack —

Thanks for the question and for attaching the draft. Short answer: we prefer invoices through the vendor portal but accept email as an exception; PO requirements depend on invoice amount and whether services were under an existing contract. High-level rules: 

- Portal (preferred): upload a PDF, map the PO field if available. Portal receipts are processed faster (2–3 business days).
- Email (fallback): invoices@redwood.ai — accepted, but they route to manual processing which can add 5–7 business days.
- PO requirement: POs are required when the invoice total >= $5,000 or if the invoice references professional services outside of a signed SOW. For amounts < $5,000 and under an existing contract, a PO is not strictly required but helps speed approvals.

A couple of notes specific to your attached file: the invoice is missing the PO field and your line items use a free-text code. For AP ingestion we prefer a 3-column line layout: SKU/Description / Quantity / Unit Price / Line Total and a clear PO number. Could you update the PDF or re-upload a CSV?

I'll loop in Ben Carter from Vendor Onboarding to share the portal link and the vendor onboarding form. Karthik — can you confirm the mapping rules for the free-text codes that Acme uses?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Jack — apologies for the delay; want to make sure we set up a repeatable path so your invoices don't get delayed in AP. Summary / decision: 

1) Preferred intake: vendor portal (https://vendors.redwood.ai/login). Ben has created a temporary vendor account for Acme and will email login + one-time upload token today. Portal uploads are prioritized by our AP system.

2) For amounts < $5,000: PO not required if the invoice is against an existing Master Agreement and line items match standard catalog entries. Since your July invoice is $3,450 and matches catalog items, we'll accept it without a PO.

3) When to include PO: include a PO for invoices >= $5,000, or any professional services work outside the Master Agreement / SOW. Please place the PO in the header field labeled "PO Number" or in the top-right of the invoice PDF.

4) File format & attachments: PDF for the invoice PDF is required. CSV or XLSX with line-item mappings is optional but recommended (we use CSV for automated ingestion). If you email invoices, include the CSV in the same thread and a short mapping note like "Code 123 -> SKU-RWD-001".

5) Edge cases / exceptions: If your internal process can't generate a PO under $5k, add a short note in the portal "no PO required per supplier policy" and we'll attach it to the vendor record. For recurring monthly charges we can also set up a billing agreement so PO generation isn't needed each month — Ben, please advise Acme on the onboarding form fields required for that flow.

Action items: 
- Ben Carter to send vendor portal invite + upload token (today).
- Karthik to review the attached CSV and confirm mapping rules (copying him).
- Jack to upload the revised PDF + CSV to the portal; if you must email, use invoices@redwood.ai and include the CSV.
